lines: British Council Scholarship for Women in STEM 2024

Full tuition fees, living stipend and other benefits

British Council Scholarship for Women in STEM 2024 is an opportunity offered by the British Council in partnership with UK universities for females pursuing postgraduate degrees in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) fields at selective universities in the UK. The scholarship aims to empower women and encourage them to pursue careers in these critical fields. Selected candidates will receive full tuition fees, living stipend and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be a female from a specific country participating in the program
hold a bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) subject
demonstrate a need for financial support/socio-economic need*
have secured admission to a pre-selected postgraduate program at a participating UK university
meet the English language proficiency requirements for postgraduate study in the UK
possess a strong interest and proven experience in the chosen STEM field
be passionate about the chosen field of study and committed to becoming a role model for future generations of women in STEM
demonstrate a plan and a passion to engage other women and girls in STEM from their home country
agree to return to their home country for at least two years after their scholarship ends
The British Council will offer institutions guidelines and a standardised framework to evaluate applicants' socio-economic needs during the scholarship application process.
Applicants will not be eligible for the scholarship under the following conditions:-
Applicants who hold dual British citizenship.
Applicants who are currently in receipt of financial support or funding towards your study program in the UK from any other source.

Applicants who have previously studied in the UK with funding from a UK government-funded scholarship or a UK institutional scholarship/financial bursary, as well as those who privately funded their UK studies.
Applicants who are an employee, a former employee, or a relative(s)* of an employee of the British Council Scholarships for Women in STEM–eligible countries.
Applicants who are an employee, a former employee, or a relative(s)* of an employee of
Her Majesty's Government including, but not limited to, British Embassies/High Commissions
Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ),
Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT)
Ministry of Defence and the Home Office

Relatives are defined as parents or stepparents, siblings or stepsiblings, children or stepchildren, spouse, civil partner, or unmarried partner (living with the applicant in a relationship akin to marriage or civil partnership for at least two years).
Selected candidates will receive the following benefits under this scholarship:-
Refund of an IELTS English language test, if needed

The selection of the candidates will be made based on academic merit, managerial experience or community involvement, and personal statement responses.
Applicants must not be receiving financial support or funding for their UK study program from any other source and must not be able to privately fund their studies in the UK.
Preference will be given to candidates who have not had any international exposure before this scheme.
Applicants must not have previously studied at a degree level or higher in the UK, nor have lived there recently. (
Distance learning at a UK university or a UK branch campus abroad will also be considered studying in the UK.)
